held_out_reason: answer_key.jsonl is published in this layer, so the family is an open-key scorer, not a held-out set: a model could read the expected labels from the same checkout. The isolation that matters here is prompt-level (the key never enters a model-facing prompt, enforced by _leak_check at build time). The held-out split is the VLUN-Prove family, whose answer key lives outside the repository and is pinned by hash in reports/prove_split_interface.json.
leak_guard: model-facing tasks.jsonl is checked (in build) to exclude expected labels, span offsets and hashes.
rights: V3 sources METADATA_ONLY (NOTICE.md): offsets+hashes only, no span text copied.
separation: answer correctness / citation existence / citation exactness / span support / abstention graded INDEPENDENTLY by scripts/score_span_tasks.py.
span_support: graded by re-reading the PINNED source at the CITED byte bounds and comparing sha256 to expected span_sha256 -- verified against the source, never against the model's own quote.
tolerance_note: citation_exactness: |cited-start-expected-start| <=T and |cited-end-expected-end| <=T with T=0 here; documented so graders and callers agree.
